title: selfdoc.py check fails on main: kbsettings keeps a fixed doc line number per setting, so one line added above the settings list in coordination.md breaks it
goal: selfdoc.py check passes on main, and each setting's line in kb/_self/coordination.md is found by its key, so a line added above the settings list cannot break the check again

run: import sys, pathlib; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import kbsettings; t = pathlib.Path('kb/_self/coordination.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); bad = kbsettings.check('a line added above the list' + chr(10) + t); print('problems with one line added above the list:', len(bad)); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
